page.overview:
Who is Tee Vee?

Tee Vee, alternatively formatted as Tee-Vee or TeeVee and also known as AT-1 in Germany, is an Alpha Team minifigure, first introduced the 2000 video game 5714 LEGO Alpha Team before appearing as a physical minifigure in 2001.

In LEGO Alpha Team, Tee Vee is portrayed as a white television (represented by a printed 1x2 brick) mounted on white minifigure legs with a black hip piece, along with black antennae and a transparent blue light bulb mounted next to the screen. His physical minifigure in 6775 Alpha Team Bomb Squad was nearly identical to his appearance in LEGO Alpha Team, but with the electric light bulb cover (part 4773) replaced with a 1x1 round plate in the same color.

In 2002, Tee Vee appears as a brick-built ROV instead of a minifigure. The ROV has a bright yellow and black colour scheme, and appears with two slight variants between 4792 Alpha Team Navigator and ROV and 4789 AT Aquatic Mech, with the latter being slightly smaller and more compact than the former.

When Alpha Team was relaunched in 2004, Tee Vee was shown to have a new android body.
